title: LLM intent output
description: The JSON the LLM must return for each customer turn. The backend validates it with Pydantic (extra fields forbidden); on failure it retries once, then uses the keyword fallback (fr/en/rn), which also produces this exact shape. The LLM only understands: it never sees a PIN, a date of birth or an account number in full, and it never decides an action.

intent.description: product_info = products, fees, services; account_opening = requirements to open an account; card_block = lost, stolen or blocked card; loan_info = loan products and repayment simulation; complaint = file or follow a complaint; branch_info = branch hours, address, phone; handoff = caller asks for a human; other = greeting, thanks, off-topic.

lang.description: Language of the customer turn (fr, en, rn = Kirundi).

entities.description: Only these keys are allowed; omit keys that are not mentioned. Sensitive values (PIN, date of birth, full account number) are NOT entities: the orchestrator collects them in code.

province.description: Province name as written in the knowledge base (e.g. Bujumbura, Gitega, Ngozi, Muyinga, Rumonge).

product.description: Product id when recognisable: current_account, savings_account, youth_account, debit_card, mobile_banking, business_loan, agri_loan, salary_advance, housing_loan, school_fees_loan, women_group_loan.

topic.description: Short free-text topic for knowledge-base search.

confidence.description: Model confidence in the intent. Below CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (default 0.5) twice in a row → handoff (reason low_confidence).

frustration.description: Caller frustration for this turn. At or above FRUSTRATION_THRESHOLD (default 0.7) → urgency raised and handoff (reason frustration).
